back: Google's family of natively multimodal foundation models (text, images, audio, video, code). Powers the Gemini app and is available via API through Google AI Studio and Vertex AI.

Pro = the most capable variant for complex reasoning, but slower and pricier. Flash = fast, low-cost, ideal for high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks. Same model family — pick capability vs. speed/cost.
Fast, developer/consumer-friendly access to Gemini via an API key. Ideal for prototyping and quick experiments. Not the enterprise-controls platform (that's Vertex AI).
Google Cloud's enterprise, fully-managed AI/ML platform. Same models as Google AI Studio, plus security, governance, IAM, data residency, MLOps, and scalability for production.
The workspace within Vertex AI to prompt, tune, test, and evaluate models before deploying them. Don't confuse with Google AI Studio (the separate prototyping tool).

Vertex AI's catalog of 100+ models to discover, test, and deploy: Google first-party (Gemini, Imagen, Veo, Chirp, Lyria), open models (Gemma), and third-party/partner models (Anthropic's Claude, Meta's Llama).
Google's family of open, lightweight models you can download and run yourself, including on your own infrastructure. Contrast with Gemini, which is offered as a hosted/managed model.
Google's first-party model for generating and editing images from text prompts.
Google's first-party model for generating video from text or images.
Google's first-party speech/audio model for capabilities like speech-to-text and text-to-speech (voice).
Toolkit to build AI agents and search/conversational apps grounded in your own data, often with little custom code. An agent understands a goal, reasons, uses tools/data, and takes actions.
Enterprise search and grounding/retrieval over your own data — Google's managed RAG (retrieval-augmented generation). Finds relevant info in your documents and feeds it to the model.
Connects Gemini to fresh, real-world web results to reduce hallucination and overcome the knowledge cutoff, anchoring answers to current, verifiable public information.
AI embedded in Docs, Gmail, Sheets, Slides, and Meet — drafting, summarizing, and generating content for everyday knowledge workers.
Part of Gemini for Google Cloud: AI help for developers to write, explain, and review code. (Cloud Assist similarly helps design and operate cloud environments.)

A grounded research/notes assistant that answers ONLY from the sources you upload and cites them (not the open web). Features include Audio Overviews. NotebookLM Enterprise adds enterprise security controls.
Google's custom-designed AI accelerator chips (ASICs), e.g. the Trillium generation, built for training and running ML models efficiently at scale. GPUs (e.g. NVIDIA) are the alternative accelerator.
Google's integrated supercomputing architecture combining optimized hardware (TPUs/GPUs), software, and networking into one system for training and serving large models at scale.
